accepted_contracts: The existing last_error TEXT field carries the full versioned marker without truncation; actual SQLite claim/commit/fresh-worker tests preserve the original client key and payload, including nested legacy envelopes.

Recognized corrupt/unsupported markers and missing/mismatched identities hold delivery without broker requests. Exhaustion emits order.reconciliation_required and does not call local order-status mutation.
Valid direct acknowledgements keep their existing path; validated recovery returns the actual broker identifier and status. Logging now distinguishes lookup-only from submission.

The root-approved redundant local os import removal restores the intended simulation branch; direct market/limit regression requires real mock results and the production guard refuses before simulated delay.
The three changed legacy fixtures provide persisted client_key only; their original quantity/order/default assertions remain.
FF10/FF11 obsolete source-text xfails are replaced by executable response recovery and actual null-quantity websocket update-path assertions.

The workflow explicitly selects both acknowledgement and adversarial suites. Release prose and acceptance matrix correctly qualify post-marker-commit restart assurance and the remaining delivery boundary.

independent_test.database: Temporary SQLite only; request transport and status mutation spies mocked.
independent_test.selection: restart_preserves or lookup_only_overrides or first_marker_commit_failure or exhaustion_reports or corrupt_unsupported or duplicate_recovery or invalid_existing or json_recursion or simulated_broker
independent_test.warning: One isolated-test warning for an ephemeral nonproduction SECRET_KEY; no installed credentials were supplied.

limitations: The 23 independently rerun cases are a subset of the authored230, not additional unique coverage; counts must not be added.
Durable lookup-only restart assurance begins after a successful marker commit. Crash/process cancellation or repeated database failure before that commit is not made atomic with broker submission.

Existing unmarked preflight uses broker-ID lookup plus a bounded list fallback; this patch does not certify exact-client recovery for all unmarked historic/process-crash cases. Original client-key idempotency remains the safeguard, and existing transport-level POST retries are unchanged.

No retrospective classification/backfill of old generic502 events; no guarantee against arbitrary marker destruction. Held events still need explicit reconciliation if neither validated lookup nor existing websocket recovery resolves them.
Temporary SQLite and mocked broker transport do not certify PostgreSQL concurrency, real broker behavior, natural trading results or profitability.

This acceptance binds the reviewed candidate files only. Root still owns final source commit, full required safety/replay pack, snapshot/freeze checks, secret/static scans, hosted CI and any separately approved deployment.

resolved_findings.finding: Lookup-only could be replaced by simulated acknowledgement after a mock/execution-mode flip.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both worker and dispatcher prioritize lookup-only over shadow, dry_run and mock routes; actual worker/dispatcher tests require GET-only and the confirmed broker ID.

resolved_findings.finding: First marker-persistence failure could enter generic retry handling and erase ambiguity.
resolved_findings.resolution: The original marker and lookup-only state are latched before persistence awaits; an injected first SQLite commit failure followed by successful persistence retains the exact marker and a fresh worker performs GET only.

resolved_findings.finding: Existing-order and duplicate-response paths bypassed new acknowledgement validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both paths now require identity/shape validation or original-client lookup; malformed/mismatched results remain unresolved.

resolved_findings.finding: Unexpected lookup errors and successful-response JSON recursion could become ordinary submission errors.
resolved_findings.resolution: Lookup failures retain BrokerAcknowledgementUnresolved; actual deeply nested HTTP200/201 decoding routes through original-key GET.

scope: Independent read-only review of three broker/outbox production files, acknowledgement behavioral tests, two replaced adversarial probes, three stable-client-key fixture corrections, and root release/workflow claims. No reviewer application/test edits or operational calls.
